hints: Suppose you already knew the depth of the left subtree and of the right subtree. What would the whole tree's depth be?
One more than the larger of the two. That is the whole recurrence, and the empty tree is the base case at 0.
Written iteratively, the same answer is the number of levels: walk the tree level by level with a queue and count the levels.
Depth counts nodes, so a single node is 1 and an empty tree is 0 - not 0 and -1.
